query.name: build-list
query.sql: SELECT project.name AS name, project.status AS status, branch.name AS branch_name, branch.status AS branch_status, node.name AS node_name, recipe.name AS recipe_name, build.id AS build_id, build.number AS number, build.tag AS tag, build.status AS build_status, build.create_date AS build_date, build.finish_date AS finish_date, build.build_duration AS build_duration, build.pass_count AS pass_count, build.fail_count AS fail_count, build.timeout_count AS timeout_count FROM porion_build AS build INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON build.project_id = project.id INNER JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON branch.id = build.branch_id INNER JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON build.recipe_id = recipe.id INNER JOIN porion_node AS node ON build.node_id = node.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN finish_date IS NULL THEN build_date ELSE finish_date END DESC
query.sql-count: SELECT count(build.id) FROM porion_build AS build

query.name: project-last-build-list
query.sql: SELECT project.name AS name, project.status AS status, branch.name AS branch_name, branch.status AS branch_status, node.name AS node_name, recipe.name AS recipe_name, build.id AS build_id, build.number AS number, build.tag AS tag, build.status AS build_status, build.create_date AS build_date, build.finish_date AS finish_date, build.build_duration AS build_duration, build.pass_count AS pass_count, build.fail_count AS fail_count, build.timeout_count AS timeout_count FROM porion_last_build AS last_build INNER JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON build.project_id = project.id INNER JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON branch.id = build.branch_id INNER JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON build.recipe_id = recipe.id INNER JOIN porion_node AS node ON build.node_id = node.id WHERE project.id = :project_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN finish_date IS NULL THEN build_date ELSE finish_date END DESC
